note: The Cluster Overview as planned (Notes/44): seven SECTION bands - Now, Inference, Estate, Memory, Agents, Network, Studio - each tile a record over a real source, one form per kind of data (numbers for counts, thermo for temperatures, small multiples for a fleet of series, pulse for a rate, ranked for a distribution, pareto for a triage, treemap for a share, agenda for a calendar, graph for a graph, stack for programmes, the iso sandboxes), reports for the small composites; every band fills the twelve columns. read.map: container <- path; dict of things <- rows named by key; other keys <- a field of each row; pick {label: path}; keys [...]. The page tiles this layout replaced are named hidden at the end.
